Down the Rabbit-Hole

Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, “and what is the use of a book,” thought Alice, “without pictures or conversations?”

So she was considering in her own mind, whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies.

Linear Algebra Review

Week 7 · Eigenvalues

An eigenvalue of a square matrix A is a number λ for which some nonzero vector v satisfies Av = λv. The vector v is an eigenvector: A only stretches it.

det(A − λI) = 0

Each eigenvalue is a root of this characteristic polynomial. A 2 × 2 matrix has at most two, and their product is det A.

Example: for A = [2 1; 1 2] the eigenvalues are 1 and 3, with eigenvectors (1, −1) and (1, 1).

Does it stay over full-screen apps?

Yes. Glaso floats in front of full-screen apps as well as ordinary windows, and ⌥ G shows or hides it from anywhere.

Can Glaso stay visible while I swipe between Spaces?

Yes — toggle Follow with ⌥ ⌘ F. With Follow off, Glaso stays put on its own Space; with it on, the window travels with you.

Is Window Mirror finished?

Window Mirror is coming soon, in two versions. In the Mac App Store version it will be view only: you click and type in the original window. The version you can download from glaso.app will add Interact, so you can work right in the mirror.

What happens when my 14-day trial ends?

Glaso falls back to the Free tier — nothing is deleted. Tabs and notes you created stay visible and usable; you just can't create new ones beyond the Free limits, and Pro features lock until you upgrade. Imported books are kept and reopen when Pro is active again.

CHAPTER I.

Down the Rabbit-Hole

Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, “and what is the use of a book,” thought Alice, “without pictures or conversations?”

So she was considering in her own mind, whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies.

Linear Algebra Review

Week 7 · Eigenvalues

An eigenvalue of a square matrix A is a number λ for which some nonzero vector v satisfies Av = λv. The vector v is an eigenvector: A only stretches it.

det(A − λI) = 0

Each eigenvalue is a root of this characteristic polynomial. A 2 × 2 matrix has at most two, and their product is det A.

Example: for A = [2 1; 1 2] the eigenvalues are 1 and 3, with eigenvectors (1, −1) and (1, 1).

More answers on the support page
Does it stay over full-screen apps?

Yes. Glaso floats in front of full-screen apps as well as ordinary windows, and ⌥ G shows or hides it from anywhere.

Can Glaso stay visible while I swipe between Spaces?

Yes — toggle Follow with ⌥ ⌘ F. With Follow off, Glaso stays put on its own Space; with it on, the window travels with you.

Is Window Mirror finished?

Window Mirror is coming soon, in two versions. In the Mac App Store version it will be view only: you click and type in the original window. The version you can download from glaso.app will add Interact, so you can work right in the mirror.

What happens when my 14-day trial ends?

Glaso falls back to the Free tier — nothing is deleted. Tabs and notes you created stay visible and usable; you just can't create new ones beyond the Free limits, and Pro features lock until you upgrade. Imported books are kept and reopen when Pro is active again.

An eigenvalue of a square matrix A is a number λ for which some nonzero vector v satisfies Av = λv. The vector v is an eigenvector: A only stretches it.

det(A − λI) = 0

Does it stay over full-screen apps?

Yes. Glaso floats in front of full-screen apps as well as ordinary windows, and ⌥ G shows or hides it from anywhere.

Can Glaso stay visible while I swipe between Spaces?

Yes — toggle Follow with ⌥ ⌘ F. With Follow off, Glaso stays put on its own Space; with it on, the window travels with you.

Is Window Mirror finished?

What happens when my 14-day trial ends?

Glaso falls back to the Free tier — nothing is deleted. Tabs and notes you created stay visible and usable; you just can't create new ones beyond the Free limits, and Pro features lock until you upgrade. Imported books are kept and reopen when Pro is active again.
